import json, signal, sys, urllib.request
from selenium import webdriver
from selenium.webdriver.chrome.service import Service
from selenium.webdriver.common.by import By
from selenium.webdriver.common.keys import Keys
from selenium.webdriver.support.ui import WebDriverWait
from selenium.webdriver.support import expected_conditions as EC
s=json.loads(sys.argv[1]);driver=None
signal.signal(signal.SIGALRM,lambda *args: (_ for _ in ()).throw(TimeoutError('Draft deadline')));signal.alarm(50)
try:
    options=webdriver.ChromeOptions();options.binary_location='/usr/bin/chromium'
    for flag in ['--headless=new','--no-sandbox','--disable-dev-shm-usage','--window-size=1440,1200']:options.add_argument(flag)
    driver=webdriver.Chrome(service=Service('/usr/bin/chromedriver'),options=options);driver.set_page_load_timeout(8);wait=WebDriverWait(driver,6)
    driver.get(s['url']);name,value=s['cookie'].split('=',1);driver.add_cookie({'name':name,'value':value,'path':'/'})
    driver.get(s['url']+'/?draft-proof=1#/issues/'+s['issueId'])
    def button(text):return wait.until(EC.element_to_be_clickable((By.XPATH,'//button[normalize-space()="'+text+'"]')))
    def write(selector,value):
        control=wait.until(EC.element_to_be_clickable((By.CSS_SELECTOR,selector)));control.send_keys(Keys.CONTROL,'a',Keys.NULL,Keys.BACKSPACE);control.send_keys(value);return control
    def api(method,path,body=None):return driver.execute_async_script("const [method,path,body,done]=arguments;fetch('/api/v1'+path,{method,headers:{'content-type':'application/json','X-Crew-Request':'1'},body:body==null?undefined:JSON.stringify(body)}).then(async r=>done({status:r.status,data:await r.json()}))",method,path,body)
    def choose(field,value):wait.until(EC.element_to_be_clickable((By.CSS_SELECTOR,'input[name="resolve-'+field+'"][value="'+value+'"]'))).click()
    def conflict():wait.until(lambda d:'changed while you were editing' in d.find_element(By.TAG_NAME,'body').text)
    if s['mode']=='decisions':
        button('Edit issue').click();button('Cancel').click();wait.until(lambda d:not d.find_elements(By.CSS_SELECTOR,'.issue-editor'))
        button('Edit issue').click();write('.issue-editor input[name="title"]','My title');write('.issue-editor textarea[name="description"]','**My body**')
        button('Cancel').click();wait.until(EC.alert_is_present()).dismiss();assert driver.find_element(By.CSS_SELECTOR,'input[name="title"]').get_attribute('value')=='My title'
        assert api('PATCH','/issues/'+s['issueId'],{'title':'Peer title','description':'**Peer body**','priority':4})['status']==200
        button('Save issue').click();conflict();assert not driver.find_element(By.XPATH,'//button[normalize-space()="Save issue"]').is_enabled()
        button('Inspect latest version').click();wait.until(EC.presence_of_element_located((By.CSS_SELECTOR,'input[name="resolve-title"]')))
        assert 'Before title' in driver.find_element(By.CSS_SELECTOR,'aside[aria-label="Unsaved draft"]').text
        assert not driver.find_element(By.XPATH,'//button[normalize-space()="Apply selected field choices"]').is_enabled()
        choose('title','mine');assert not driver.find_element(By.XPATH,'//button[normalize-space()="Apply selected field choices"]').is_enabled();choose('description','latest');button('Apply selected field choices').click()
        assert driver.find_element(By.CSS_SELECTOR,'textarea[name="description"]').get_attribute('value')=='**Peer body**'
        button('Save issue').click();wait.until(lambda d:not d.find_elements(By.CSS_SELECTOR,'.issue-editor'))
        saved=api('GET','/issues/'+s['issueId'])['data']['issue'];assert saved['title']=='My title' and saved['description']=='**Peer body**' and saved['priority']==4
        button('Edit issue').click();write('.issue-editor input[name="title"]','Discard title');button('Cancel').click();wait.until(EC.alert_is_present()).accept();wait.until(lambda d:not d.find_elements(By.CSS_SELECTOR,'.issue-editor'))
        button('Edit comment').click();write('form:has(legend) textarea[name="body"]','**My comment**');assert api('PATCH','/comments/'+s['commentId'],{'body':'**Peer comment**'})['status']==200
        button('Save comment').click();conflict();button('Inspect latest version').click();choose('body','mine');button('Apply selected field choices').click();button('Save comment').click();wait.until(lambda d:not d.find_elements(By.XPATH,'//legend[normalize-space()="Edit comment"]'))
        assert api('GET','/comments/'+s['commentId'])['data']['comment']['body']=='**My comment**'
        driver.execute_script('location.hash=arguments[0]','/projects/'+s['projectId']+'/labels');button('Edit Before label').click();write('input[name="name"]','My label');assert api('PATCH','/labels/'+s['labelId'],{'name':'Peer label','color':'#222222'})['status']==200
        button('Save label').click();conflict();button('Inspect latest version').click();choose('name','mine');button('Apply selected field choices').click();button('Save label').click();wait.until(lambda d:'My label' in d.find_element(By.TAG_NAME,'body').text)
        saved=api('GET','/labels/'+s['labelId'])['data']['label'];assert saved['name']=='My label' and saved['color']=='#222222'
        button('Edit My label').click();write('input[name="name"]','Retained label');button('Cancel editing').click();wait.until(EC.alert_is_present()).dismiss();assert driver.find_element(By.CSS_SELECTOR,'input[name="name"]').get_attribute('value')=='Retained label'
    else:
        button('Edit comment').click();textarea=write('form:has(legend) textarea[name="body"]','Retained revoked comment')
        request=urllib.request.Request(s['url']+'/api/v1/projects/'+s['projectId']+'/guests/'+s['guestId'],method='DELETE',headers={'Cookie':s['adminCookie'],'X-Crew-Request':'1'})
        with urllib.request.urlopen(request,timeout=6) as response:assert response.status==200
        button('Save comment').click();wait.until(lambda d:'no longer editable with your current access' in d.find_element(By.TAG_NAME,'body').text)
        assert textarea.get_attribute('value')=='Retained revoked comment' and not textarea.is_enabled()
        assert not driver.find_element(By.XPATH,'//button[normalize-space()="Save comment"]').is_enabled()
        button('Inspect latest version').click();wait.until(lambda d:'no longer editable with your current access' in d.find_element(By.TAG_NAME,'body').text)
        assert textarea.get_attribute('value')=='Retained revoked comment'
        button('Cancel comment editing').click();wait.until(EC.alert_is_present()).dismiss();assert textarea.get_attribute('value')=='Retained revoked comment'
    print(json.dumps({'ok':True,'mode':s['mode']}))
except Exception:
    if driver:print(json.dumps({'body':driver.find_element(By.TAG_NAME,'body').text,'url':driver.current_url}),file=sys.stderr)
    raise
finally:
    signal.alarm(0)
    if driver:driver.quit()
